commands.title: Look up a link
commands.description: Is this link safe to open? Resolves shorteners and redirects and checks where it really goes; on a shortener, says whether the shortener itself disabled, flagged or removed the link. Cost: 1 credit, deep 30.

args.name: deep
args.description: Also read linked pages and verify claimed brands (needs an API key).

commands.title: Look up a domain
commands.description: Domain age, lookalike-brand technique, abused TLD, blocklist status and a verdict. Cost: 1 credit, deep 30.

args.name: deep
args.description: Also read linked pages and verify claimed brands (needs an API key).

commands.title: Find related domains
commands.description: Which other domains share infrastructure or a kit with this one: the same IP address, /24, ASN or name servers (from Bewary's own DNS history), one certificate, a registrar and registration time, a page template or a tracking id. Each relation has a strength; CDNs and shared hosting are not pivoted on. Each related domain carries its own verdict. A relation is a link, not proof of common ownership. Cost: 5 credits a page; API key required.

commands.title: Look up an IP address
commands.description: Network owner, ASN, country, hosting type, reverse DNS. Cost: 1 credit.

commands.title: Look up a phone number
commands.description: Country, number type, blocklist status and a verdict for a phone number. Cost: 1 credit, with line type 10.

args.name: line_type
args.description: Add the live line type (needs an API key).

commands.title: Look up an SMS short code
commands.description: Who operates this SMS short code, and is it legitimate, shared or a scam code? Cost: 1 credit.

commands.title: Look up an email address
commands.description: Mail server, disposable or free provider, role mailbox, and the sender domain's facts. Cost: 1 credit.

commands.title: Look up a crypto wallet
commands.description: Is this wallet on Bewary's scam list? Cost: 1 credit.

commands.title: Look up an IBAN
commands.description: Is this IBAN valid (country length and structure, check digits), which bank does it belong to (name, BIC), and did a community report name it? Pass the country the payee claims to catch a mismatch. Cost: 1 credit.

args.name: iban
args.description: Electronic or print form, spaces allowed.

args.name: claimed_country
args.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the payee claims.

commands.title: Look up a mobile app
commands.description: Is this app live on the Apple App Store or Google Play, or did the store pull it? Name, developer, rating count and when we first and last saw it live. Cost: 1 credit.

args.name: app_id
args.description: Apple: numeric App Store id. Google Play: package name, e.g. com.whatsapp.

args.name: storefront
args.description: Apple only: App Store country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

commands.title: Look up a payment handle
commands.description: Does this Cash App $Cashtag, PayPal.me name or Venmo username exist, is it active, and is it on Bewary's scam list? Existence and status only, never the person's name. Cost: 1 credit.

args.name: handle
args.description: The $Cashtag, PayPal.me name or Venmo username.

commands.title: Watch an entity
commands.description: Get events when a domain, phone number, wallet or brand changes: a domain's IP addresses, name servers, down/up/parked, re-registered, expiring or expired; a listing or delisting; a new lookalike domain of a brand. Watching it again updates the event types. Cost: 1 credit a day (a brand watch also 1 per lookalike event); API key required.

args.name: value
args.description: A domain, an E.164 number, a wallet address or a brand id.

args.name: events
args.description: Omit for every event of the type.

commands.title: Stop watching
commands.description: Delete a watch: no more events or charges. Its events stay readable. Cost: free.

commands.title: List watches
commands.description: Every live watch on the account. Cost: free; API key required.

commands.title: Read events
commands.description: Events of the account's watches, oldest first. Keep next_cursor and pass it as cursor to read only what came after. Cost: free; API key required.

DOMAIN_DECEPTIVE_STRUCTURE: A brand name placed before an @ so the real host hides after it
SHORTCODE_LEGITIMATE: A short code a real company sends from
SHORTCODE_MIXED_USE: A shared short code used by several senders
SHORTCODE_SCAM: A short code known for scam texts
SHORTCODE_UNREGISTERED: A short code not in the directory
IP_LISTED: An address on a confirmed abuse list
IP_DATACENTER_FOR_SENDER: A sender hosted in a datacenter, not a home or business network
PHONE_FTC_COMPLAINTS: Complaints about this number at the FTC
PHONE_FCC_COMPLAINTS: Complaints about this number at the FCC
DOMAIN_CERT_LT_48H: First TLS certificate issued in the last 48 hours
WALLET_LISTED: A wallet on a confirmed scam list
WALLET_SANCTIONED: A wallet on a US sanctions list
WALLET_FROZEN_BY_ISSUER: A wallet a stablecoin issuer froze
LISTED_CAUTION: On a broad threat list that also holds spam and malware hosts
PHONE_REPORTED_CALLER_ID: Shown as the caller ID of complained-about calls, which callers can fake
PROTECTIVE_DNS_BLOCKED: Blocked by public protective DNS resolvers
PLATFORM_TAKEDOWN: The hosting platform took it down
PLATFORM_WARNING: The platform shows a phishing or malware warning in front of it
DOMAIN_REGISTRY_HOLD: The registry holds the domain out of the DNS
HANDLE_REPORTED: A payment handle reported in scams
IBAN_CHECKSUM_INVALID: The IBAN fails its check digits
IBAN_FORMAT_INVALID: Not a valid IBAN for its country
IBAN_COUNTRY_MISMATCH: The account is in another country than the payee claims
IBAN_BANK_UNKNOWN: No bank uses the IBAN's bank code
IBAN_BANK_CLOSED: The IBAN's bank code is no longer in use
IBAN_ACCOUNT_CHECK_FAILED: The account number fails its bank's check digit
IBAN_INTERNAL_ACCOUNT: An account number banks keep for their own use
IBAN_BANK_SANCTIONED: The IBAN's bank is on a sanctions list
SHORTLINK_DISABLED: The link shortener disabled the link
SHORTLINK_WARNING: The link shortener warns before the destination
HANDLE_INACTIVE: The payment profile is not active
TEXT_CREDENTIAL_REQUEST: Asks for a password or login
TEXT_URGENCY: Pushes the reader to act fast
TEXT_THREAT: Threatens a penalty, arrest or lost account
TEXT_UNEXPECTED_REWARD: Offers a prize, refund or money out of nowhere
TEXT_CALLBACK_REQUEST: Asks the reader to call a number
TEXT_SENDER_BRAND_MISMATCH: The sender does not match the brand it claims to be
TEXT_LINK_BRAND_MISMATCH: The link does not go to the brand it claims to be
PAGE_CREDENTIAL_HARVEST: The page asks for a login it should not
PAGE_PAYMENT_HARVEST: The page asks for card or bank details it should not
CLASS_OWN_RECORD: The user's own receipt or record, not an inbound message
CLASS_NOT_SECURITY_RELEVANT: Nothing to judge: no request, link or claim
